Free CV builder that follows recruiter and ATS rules. Everything runs on your own computer: your CV is not sent anywhere unless you connect an AI service yourself.

## Download

Pick your computer and click **Download**. Nothing to install.

| Your computer | Download | Then |
|---|---|---|
| 🪟 **Windows** 10 or 11 | **[⬇️ Download for Windows](https://github.com/SoloSaftis/CVBuilder/releases/download/__TAG__/CVBuilder-windows-x64-portable.zip)** | Open the downloaded folder and double-click **CVBuilder** |
| 🍎 **Mac** with Apple chip (M1 or newer) | **[⬇️ Download for Mac](https://github.com/SoloSaftis/CVBuilder/releases/download/__TAG__/CVBuilder-macos-arm64.zip)** | Open the download and drag **CVBuilder** to Applications |
| 🐧 **Linux** | **[⬇️ Download for Linux](https://github.com/SoloSaftis/CVBuilder/releases/download/__TAG__/CVBuilder-linux-x86_64.AppImage)** | Right-click the file → Properties → allow running as a program, then double-click it |

Not sure which Mac you have? Click the Apple menu → **About This Mac**. If it says *Chip: Apple M…*, use the Mac download.

## The first time you open it

The app is not signed yet, so your computer may warn you once:

- **Windows** says "Windows protected your PC": click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Mac** says Apple "could not verify" CVBuilder: click **Done**, open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.

## What it does

- Import your old CV (Word, PDF and more) or start from scratch, then write in a simple form and see the pages as they will look, while you type.
- Paste or fetch the job ad: CVBuilder shows which of its keywords are missing from your CV.
- A recruiter checklist shows what is missing before you download.
- Download a PDF with real, searchable text, or Word.
- 31 designs, your own colours and page layout. Menus and CV headings in 86 languages, offline.
- Optional AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok or a local model).
